icons.name: camera
icons.description: A compact camera with a continuous curved body and circular lens.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Owner-requested rounder unboxed camera with the left/right primary edge pair at exactly 2 native units. Both style exteriors span x=2..22 and y=3.49175127..20.50824873, centered at 12,12. The natural horizontal body proportions are retained (20 by 17.01649746); the shorter vertical axis is not stretched to force 2px top/bottom margins. Outline uses circular tangent fillets and unchanged Regular 1.70 stroke. Filled exterior is the exact 0.85 outward offset of the same lines and arcs, increasing convex radii and reducing concave radii while keeping arc centers fixed. No enclosing box is added. Camera body corner radii are 2.75 at shoulders and 3.25 at the base; the raised housing has softened .8/1.05 transitions. The owner then requested lowering the raised housing by .75 unit relative to the body. The complete drawing is recentered upward by .375 unit, including lens and indicator; circle radii remain unchanged; Filled counters remain their established fixed geometry. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved both Outline and Filled after rounder corners, exact 2px left/right primary margins, and the .75-unit lower raised housing. Reviewed at native proportions and Regular 1.70.

icons.name: copy
icons.description: Two overlapping rounded pages with a distinct foreground sheet.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Owner-requested greater separation and the standard Camera/Folder main-body corner roundness. Both page centerlines use radius 3.25 with unchanged Regular 1.70 stroke and .85 round caps. Nominal rear page centerline bounds are 2.85..15.45; front page centerline bounds are 8.55..21.15 on both axes. The offset is 5.70, producing a 4.00-unit clear straight gap between the exposed parallel borders (previously 2.80). Combined visible bounds are 2..22 on both axes, with balanced 2px artboard margins. The owner requested breaks at both rear/front junctions. The rear path now starts at 5.85 15.44037035 and ends at 15.44037035 5.85, trimmed along the existing corner arcs so each radius-.85 end cap stops exactly 1 unit before the visible foreground border. These two endpoint clearances are separate from the 4-unit parallel-border gap. The front page stays unchanged. Filled uses the exact Outline exterior: outer corner radius 4.10, rear-band inner radius 2.40 and .85 end caps. Its front page is solid, with no added enclosing box or artificial hole. Position and visible exterior match between styles at native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70. Both styles were owner-approved on 2026-10-27.

review.note: Owner approved both Outline and Filled Copy with standard Camera/Folder roundness, 4px exposed page spacing, 1px breaks at both rear junctions and 2px outer margins.

review.note: Owner approved Moon Outline and Filled after the fuller crescent and deeper inner-arc revisions. Final geometry uses a radius-8 outer arc and radius-10 inner concavity, at native proportions and Regular 1.70.
